topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: I can't believe it—after all these months of talking, messaging, and sharing, it turns out Alex lives in the same city. We've built this whole online connection, and now there's this thrilling possibility of meeting in person. The city feels a bit smaller, a bit friendlier, knowing someone on the other side of my screen is actually a real, physical presence here too. We're already planning our first meet-up, and I find myself looking forward to it more than I can remember looking forward to anything in a while. The idea of turning an online friendship into a real-world one? It's beyond exciting.
